sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another Counsel for Applicant :- Chandra Prakash Pandey,Praveen Kumar Srivastava,Saurabh Shukla,
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Shweta Singh Rana Hon'ble Raj Beer Singh,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the entire record.
None has appeared on behalf of the informant.

2. The present bail application has been filed by the applicant in case crime No. 375/2020, under Section 376, 506 IPC & Section 3/4 of POCSO Act and Section 3(2)(5) of SC/ST Act, police station Shankargarh, District Prayagraj with the prayer to enlarge the applicant on bail.
3. It has been argued by learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant-accused is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in this case.
It was submitted that the first information report was lodged by the informant, alleging that applicant has physically exploited her minor daughter and resultantly she became pregnant.

In her statements, recorded under Sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C.,
Mahfooz Ali vs State Of U.P. And Another on 15 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/103802197/
1 victim has made false allegations that applicant Mahfooz Ali has committed rape upon her and that she was pregnant.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It was pointed out that statement of victim has already been recorded before the trial court as PW-1, certified copy of the same has been filed along with the supplementary affidavit.

It was also pointed out that in her statement before the trial court, victim has stated that applicant has not committed any rape upon her and she was not having pregnancy of the child of applicant and she has also denied her statement recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C.
She has further stated that the first information report was lodged by her mother, who has since passed away.
It was pointed out that in her statement before the trial court, victim has not made any allegation against the applicant.
It was submitted that the applicant is in judicial custody since 14.10.2021, having no criminal history, but there are a number of formal witnesses, who are yet to be examined before the trial court.
Lastly, it was submitted that in case, applicant is enlarged on bail, the applicant will not misuse the liberty of bail.

4. Learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail and argued that during investigation, victim has made allegation of rape against the applicant but it could not be disputed that during trial victim did not support the prosecution version and turn hostile.

5. Considering the submissions of learned counsel for the parties, nature of accusations, period of custody and all attending facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, a case for bail is made out.
Hence, the bail application is hereby allowed.

6. Let the applicant Mahfooz Ali involved in the aforesaid crime be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond and two local sureties each of the like amount to the satisfaction of court concerned subject to the following conditions:
i. The applicant will not tamper with the evidence during trial.
ii.
The applicant will not pressurize/intimidate the prosecution witnesses.
iii. The applicant will appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.
iv. The applicant will not try to contact, threat or otherwise influence the complainant or any of the witness of the case.
7. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the court concerned shall be at liberty to cancel the bail of applicant, in accordance with law.

Order Date :- 15.2.2024 Anand  Mahfooz Ali vs State Of U.P. And Another on 15 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/103802197/
